title: Animals
parentNote: This unit covers types of animals, their homes, food habits, and how they move. Visit a zoo or watch animal videos together!
learnBullets: Know the difference between **domestic and wild animals**
Understand what animals eat — **herbivores, carnivores, omnivores**
Know how different animals **move** (walk, fly, swim, crawl)
Learn about **animal babies** and their names
learnItFirst:
**1. Types of Animals**

**Domestic Animals** — Animals that live with humans
- Dog, Cat, Cow, Horse, Goat, Hen, Sheep
- They give us milk, eggs, wool, or help us

**Wild Animals** — Animals that live in forests/jungles
- Lion, Tiger, Elephant, Bear, Wolf, Deer
- They find their own food and shelter

**Pet Animals** — Animals we keep at home for company
- Dog, Cat, Fish, Parrot, Rabbit

---

**2. What Animals Eat**

| Type | What They Eat | Examples |
|------|---------------|----------|
| **Herbivores** | Only plants | Cow, Goat, Rabbit, Deer, Elephant |
| **Carnivores** | Only other animals | Lion, Tiger, Wolf, Eagle |
| **Omnivores** | Both plants and animals | Dog, Bear, Crow, Humans |

---

**3. Animal Homes**

| Animal | Home |
|--------|------|
| Dog | Kennel |
| Cow | Shed / Barn |
| Bird | Nest |
| Bee | Hive |
| Lion | Den |
| Rabbit | Burrow |
| Spider | Web |
| Fish | Water (Pond, River, Sea) |
| Horse | Stable |

---

**4. How Animals Move**

- **Walk/Run** — Dog, Cat, Cow, Lion
- **Fly** — Bird, Butterfly, Bat
- **Swim** — Fish, Duck, Whale
- **Crawl** — Snake, Snail, Worm
- **Hop/Jump** — Frog, Rabbit, Kangaroo

---

**5. Animal Babies**

| Animal | Baby |
|--------|------|
| Dog | Puppy |
| Cat | Kitten |
| Cow | Calf |
| Hen | Chick |
| Lion | Cub |
| Frog | Tadpole |

---

questions.content: Which of these is a domestic animal?
questions.why: A cow lives with humans and gives us milk — it is a domestic animal

questions.content: Which of these is a wild animal?
questions.why: A tiger lives in the jungle and hunts for food — it is a wild animal

questions.content: A dog lives in a ___.
questions.why: A dog's house is called a kennel

questions.content: Which animal gives us milk?
questions.why: Cows give us milk that we drink

questions.content: A bird lives in a ___.
questions.why: Birds build nests in trees using twigs, leaves, and grass

questions.content: Which animal can fly?
questions.why: A parrot is a bird with wings — it can fly

questions.content: A baby dog is called a ___.
questions.why: A baby dog is called a puppy

questions.content: Which animal swims in water?
questions.why: Fish live in water and swim using their fins

questions.content: Which animal gives us eggs?
questions.why: Hens lay eggs that we eat

questions.content: A snake moves by ___.
questions.why: Snakes have no legs — they crawl on the ground

questions.content: Animals that eat only plants are called ___.
questions.why: Herbivores eat only plants (grass, leaves, fruits)

questions.content: Animals that eat only other animals are called ___.
questions.why: Carnivores hunt and eat other animals

questions.content: Which of these is an omnivore?
questions.why: Bears eat both plants (berries) and animals (fish) — they are omnivores

questions.content: A lion lives in a ___.
questions.why: A lion's home is called a den

questions.content: Which animal hops to move?
questions.why: Frogs have strong back legs and hop to move

questions.content: A baby cat is called a ___.
questions.why: A baby cat is called a kitten

questions.content: Bees live in a ___.
questions.why: Bees live together in a hive and make honey there

questions.content: Which of these animals gives us wool?
questions.why: Sheep have soft, fuzzy hair that we use to make wool

questions.content: A rabbit lives in a ___.
questions.why: Rabbits dig holes called burrows to live in

questions.content: Which of these is a pet animal?
questions.why: Goldfish are kept in tanks at home as pets

questions.content: A horse lives in a ___.
questions.why: A horse's home is called a stable

questions.content: Which animal has a shell on its back?
questions.why: A tortoise carries a hard shell on its back for protection

questions.content: A baby cow is called a ___.
questions.why: A baby cow is called a calf

questions.content: A spider makes a ___ to catch insects.
questions.why: Spiders spin webs to trap insects for food

questions.content: Which of these can live both on land and in water?
questions.why: Frogs can live on land and in water — they are amphibians

sections.name: Achiever's Corner
sections.leadingContext: These questions are a bit tricky. Think carefully!

questions.content: Rohan said, "All animals that fly are birds." Is he correct?

options.A: No, because fish can also fly
options.B: Yes, because all birds have wings
options.D: No, bats can fly but they are not birds

questions.why: Bats can fly but they are mammals, not birds. Insects like butterflies can also fly

questions.content: A penguin is a bird. Why can't it fly?

options.B: Its wings are too small for flying but help in swimming
options.C: It is not really a bird

questions.why: Penguins have small, flipper-like wings that help them swim, not fly

questions.content: A baby frog is called a tadpole. It looks very different from a frog because it ___.

options.B: Has a tail but no legs

questions.why: Tadpoles have tails and no legs. As they grow, they develop legs and lose their tail

questions.content: A camel is called the "ship of the desert" because it ___.

options.D: Can travel long distances in the desert without much water

questions.why: Camels can store water in their body and walk long distances in hot deserts carrying heavy loads

questions.content: Meena saw an animal that gives milk, has horns, and says "moo." But it is NOT a cow. What animal could it be?
questions.why: A buffalo also gives milk, has horns, and makes a sound similar to "moo"
